profile.subtitleJa: ギブオン荒野の道沿いにある丘
profile.summaryJa: サムエル記下2:24では、ヨアブとアビシャイがアブネルを追い、日没時にギアの前のアンマの丘へ来たと記されます。本文は丘の現代位置を示しません。

profile.locationNoteJa: ギアおよびギブオン荒野との位置関係は記されますが、現代位置は不明です。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner. The sun went down when they had come to the hill of Ammah, that lies before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.

wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: Identifies Ammah as the name of the hill Joab and Abishai reached at sunset while pursuing Abner, explicitly citing 2 Samuel 2:24; it places the hill east of Gibeon but gives no modern identification.
